limitations: These are permission counts, not diagram availability, correctness, or live-browser success counts.
The ID API validates worksheet identity/shape, not actual question existence; callers must retain exact manifest exercise membership and source-integrity validation.
The elementary catalog currently has no Ramzi viewer prefixes; unsupported and unknown worksheets fail closed.
No PDF, source JSON, SVG, exercise text, table or manifest is changed by this policy.
Prior 120/63 visual audits are immutable historical evidence. The new worksheet policy intentionally disables their non-geometry visuals.
